name: empty-input
bug_class: empty-input crash (reduce on an empty array)
real_breakage: GET /api/stats returns HTTP 500 — the real score store is empty and summarize() calls reduce() with no initial value, which throws on an empty array. The requested /version feature is unrelated.
green_tests: tests/stats.test.mjs only feeds populated score lists; the empty store the app actually ships with is never exercised
